source.title: Synthesis and Characterization of Nearly Monodisperse CdE (E = S, Se, Te) Semiconductor Nanocrystallites
source.authors: C. B. Murray, D. J. Norris, M. G. Bawendi
source.scope: All 10 main-article pages inspected. Matching SI not located or verified; do not infer no SI ever existed.

evidence_rules: Record IDs identify figure-specific observations, not author-assigned unique batch IDs. No universal cross-figure identity or exact synthesis-time mapping is provided.
Reported diameters mean major axis. Angstrom-to-nanometre conversions do not add measurement precision.
Equal-size TEM, optical and diffraction samples must not automatically be joined as the same specimen, or declared different specimens.
No curves have been digitized; no exact peak positions are inferred from graphs.
An ideal wurtzite rendering is illustrative. Actual particles show stacking faults; surface disorder is compatible with diffraction data and included in the authors' nonunique model.
TOP/TOPO is the synthesis cap; TEM preparation uses a pyridine dispersion. Do not infer exact ligand coverage on an imaged particle.

tem.imaging: Bright field; aperture permits lattice images of (100), (002), (101) wurtzite planes.
tem.grid: 300-mesh copper, approximately 50 A amorphous carbon film
tem.preparation: Apply dilute pyridine dispersion; wait approximately 1 minute; wick away solution. Coverage controlled by concentration and contact time.
tem.sampling_note: Method discussion describes 30-50 particles measured on a single image. This is not an explicitly assigned N for each panel.

xrd.sample: Approximately 500 mg washed/dried powder pressed at 5000 psi into 0.5-inch pellets, without amorphous binder.
xrd.note: Only unambiguous acquisition fields carried here; do not silently modernize or correct printed instrument parameters.

photoluminescence.note: The 1-mm cuvettes apply to the relative-yield comparison; the separate absorption method uses 1-cm cuvettes.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: Dispersed, slightly prolate CdSe particles imaged with bright-field lattice contrast.
findings: Elongated (002) direction; particles are not aggregated.
Nearly circular cross-section when viewed along the long axis; other projections appear oblong.
limitations: Relative spreads describe population size distributions, not single-particle instrumental error bars.
Authors describe boundary uncertainty of approximately one atomic plane; measured distribution widths are measurement-limited.
No atom coordinates or exact sample growth schedule are supplied.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: Atomic-contrast image of an approximately 80 A CdSe crystallite with planar disorder.
limitations: No short-axis size or complete recipe-time assignment.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: Two oriented particles illustrate stacking faults and a hexagonal lattice projection.
findings: Left particle loses lattice contrast in (101) planes, interpreted as four faults along (002).
Neighboring particle displays the hexagonal lattice projection.
limitations: Caption and body give approximately 1.3 and 1.33; any derived short axis must be marked calculated.
Projection changes fault visibility. Absence of visible faults does not establish defect-free structure.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: Near-monolayer of 51 A CdSe particles with short-range hexagonal packing.
findings: Local two-dimensional hexagonal close packing at higher coverage.
limitations: This is packing of separate particles, not the atomic lattice or evidence of long-range single-crystal order.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: Approximately 35 A CdS, CdSe and CdTe particles compared with bulk wurtzite CdS peak positions.
findings: All three samples described as predominantly wurtzite with bulk-like spacings.
limitations: Three different materials, not one CdSe sample.
Bulk reference markers in this panel are specifically for wurtzite CdS.

structural_experiments.caption_paraphrase: CdSe size-series diffraction compared with bulk wurtzite peak positions.
findings: Extra attenuation/broadening of (102) and (103) is associated with stacking disorder.
The 1.2-nm cluster is too small for meaningful wurtzite-versus-zincblende core classification.
limitations: Optical Figure 3 has different size labels; do not pair arrays by index.
Peak widths mix size, defects and overlapping reflections.

structural_model_comparisons.caption_paraphrase: Compare ideal zincblende, ideal wurtzite and faulted wurtzite with experiment.
findings: One fault improves agreement, particularly by broadening the (103) feature.
structural_model_comparisons.source_internal_difference: Caption gives approximately 35 A; discussion on p8712 refers to a 1000-atom approximately 37 A sphere. Preserve this source difference.

structural_model_comparisons.caption_paraphrase: Spherical and prolate models compared with an approximately 80 A sample.
findings: Prolate shape improves the dominant (002) contribution in the first diffraction feature.
limitations: Aspect ratio and fault density are evidence-constrained model parameters.

structural_model_comparisons.caption_paraphrase: A small sample tests shape, lattice contraction and surface disorder.

panels.model: same prolate model plus moderate surface disorder

findings: Shape improves overall agreement without requiring large lattice contraction.
Surface disorder improves the first feature but does not uniquely identify a surface reconstruction.
limitations: The 2% contraction is a tested model, not a measured conclusion.

structural_model_comparisons.caption_paraphrase: Approximately 37 A crystallites compared with a prolate, faulted, surface-relaxed model.
structural_model_comparisons.source_internal_difference: Caption says one fault; main text gives mean defect density 1.3 faults/crystallite. Do not conceal that difference.
findings: Faults mainly affect 2theta approximately 30-50 degrees; shape shifts the first feature near 25 degrees; surface disorder changes that feature's shape.
limitations: Fitted ensemble model, not observed coordinates of a unique particle.

saed.status: reported qualitatively; no corresponding image/pattern panel
saed.limitation: Preferred orientation on grids impairs electron-diffraction line-shape interpretation, so authors do not emphasize SAED.
saed.do_not: Do not label TEM lattice images or powder XRD curves as SAED.

electron_microdiffraction.basis: Cited reference 19, not a new result.

edx.finding: XRD and EDX identify gray byproduct as mainly elemental Cd and Se.
edx.do_not: Do not call this retained-product stoichiometry or purity.

exafs.status: cited prior work used as simulation constraints; no new EXAFS spectrum
references: Marcus et al., J. Phys. Chem. 1991, 95, 1572
exafs.do_not: Do not label these as EXAFS measurements newly acquired in Murray 1993.
exafs.model_values_note: 2.63 A is the bulk CdSe bond length adopted with support from prior EXAFS. The 0.04 A^2 mean-square displacement is the constant thermal-disorder parameter used in these diffraction simulations, described as consistent with prior EXAFS; it is not a newly measured EXAFS result in this paper.

overall_structure.evidence_kind: author interpretation of TEM, XRD fits and cited constraints
overall_structure.finding: Predominantly wurtzite, slightly prolate particles with roughly one stacking fault per 6-7 planes along the elongated direction. Bulk-like mean bond length; surface disorder compatible with data.
overall_structure.limitation: Pure wurtzite/zincblende labels hide stacking disorder; surface geometry is not uniquely resolved.

optical_properties.caption_paraphrase: Size selection narrows the size distribution and sharpens CdSe absorption.
optical_properties.wavelength_note: 400 nm is approximate; these are absorption transitions, not PL peaks.
limitations: Illustrated sequence is not a universal wash count.

optical_properties.caption_paraphrase: CdS, CdSe and CdTe of approximately 2-3 nm show confinement-shifted absorption.
optical_properties.bulk_value_status: Bulk band-gap wavelengths used for comparison, not these nanoparticles' peak wavelengths.
findings: CdSe shows three resolved transitions. Authors attribute spectral-quality differences partly to optimization effort, not intrinsic CdS/CdTe limitations.

optical_properties.size_label_note: Three smallest labels have approximate signs; unit conversion adds no precision.
findings: Absorption shifts toward longer wavelength with increasing size.
limitations: This is not a measured emission-color or quantum-yield series.
No unique growth times are assigned.

optical_properties.evidence_kind: experimental transition energies compared with theory
optical_properties.caption_paraphrase: Size-dependent lowest optical transition compared with an effective-mass approximation.

curve_key.solid: effective-mass approximation with first-order Coulomb treatment

findings: Closer agreement for larger particles; the simple theory diverges at small sizes.
optical_properties.size_evidence: TEM sizes checked by XRD line-shape analysis.
limitations: No numerical table; graph not digitized.
Solid curve is theory, not a universal synthesis-to-property predictor.
Improved tight-binding treatment mentioned is prior work, reference 14.

optical_properties.caption_paraphrase: Absorption and band-edge emission of a 35 A CdSe sample at room temperature.
limitations: No numerical lifetime or decay trace.
Do not assign 9.6% to every Figure 3 size.
Identity with Figure 6 TEM sample is unestablished.

optical_properties.finding: Samples in original growth solution retained strong, sharp emission after more than one year.
optical_properties.sample_specificity: No figure-specific sample ID or detailed storage conditions.
optical_properties.limitation: Not a quantified photostability test under continuous illumination.

Raman.evidence: No Raman spectrum, acquisition method or result in the 10-page main article. Introductory mention of vibrational confinement is context, not Raman data.
Raman.si_scope: Matching SI unverified; statement applies to inspected main article.

other_unreported_quantities: Tabulated spectra or exact absorption/PL maxima for every size

displayed_figure_assets.policy: Faithful cropped raster extracts of original published panels; axes, internal labels and scale bar retained. No redrawing or curve digitization.
